item.title: Presidential runoff under way in Brazil
item.description: Brazil is also heading to the polls today for a run-off vote that will decide who leads the country. The son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, Flávio scored a major upset in the first round earlier this month, taking the lead in the vote. The campaign has been dominated by corruption scandals, economic difficulties and allegations of US interference, which Washington has denied. The German brand’s chief executive, Gernot Döllner, joined Trump on stage at a campaign rally on Saturday night to announce the factory in Macon, Georgia, in an unusual move by a big European brand just days before the US midterm elections. item.title: Trump's 250-foot arch could see construction begin November 5 despite pending legal challenge
item.description: US President Donald Trump's proposed 250-foot triumphal arch in Washington could begin construction as early as November 5, pending final approvals. item.title: En 1941, el acorazado USS Arizona se hundió en Pearl Harbor. EEUU ya tiene su "sucesor": un submarino nuclear con 28 Tomahawk más
item.description: Construido en 1916 y ya operativo en la Primera Guerra Mundial, el acorazado de la clase Pennsylvania USS Arizona se hundió de forma catastrófica durante el ataque japonés a Pearl Harbor en plena Segunda Guerra Mundial. Fallecieron 1.177 personas y el barco nunca se recuperó del fondo del mar, por lo que hoy hace las veces de monumento a la memoria de quienes perdieron la vida. 85 años después, la Marina de Estados Unidos está construyendo a su sucesor (al menos en el nombre): un submarino con tecnología avanzada y cargado de misiles hasta la bandera. item.title: Obama hits campaign trail for democrats
item.description: With less than two weeks to go before the US midterm elections, former President Barack Obama has hit the campaign trail, rallying support for Democratic candidates in the key states of Michigan and Ohio. item.title: 24-year-old Coast Guard swimmer rescues 16 people from Pacific shipwreck after two hours in darkness
item.description: A US Coast Guard rescue swimmer undertook a challenging operation to save 16 individuals from the Pacific Ocean. The rescue followed a distress call regarding a capsized boat off Mexico's Baja California. Over 2,441 square miles were searched, but 11 victims remain missing as the search was suspended. Investigation into the vessel's circumstances is ongoing, and survivors received medical care before being processed under US immigration law. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: At least 12 injured in late-night shooting near Florida A&M University stadium in Tallahassee
item.description: A shooting occurred near a football stadium in Tallahassee during homecoming weekend at Florida A&M University. At least 12 individuals were injured, which included six children, and 11 had gunshot wounds. Authorities reported that three victims suffered serious injuries, with one critically injured and eight stable. The police chief indicated an altercation had preceded the shooting, but no arrests have been made. Publicado también por: The Times of India - World, The Hindu - International. item.description: Nilesh Undavia and other buyers are struggling to receive their deposits for unfinished luxury condos in Boca Raton.
